description: This file defines the JSON schema and API interface for the DataCapture plugin, including methods for enabling audio capture and requesting audio clips, along with associated events and metadata.

methods.name: enableAudioCapture
methods.description: Enables audio capturing to buffer with specified maximum duration, returning status and error codes.

methods.name: getAudioClip
methods.description: Requests the audio driver to capture an audio sample from a specified stream and deliver it to a URL, with parameters for stream type, destination URL, duration, and capture mode.
